critical_code_review_comments: P0 ROOT CAUSE confirmed for production data loss: reconcile_tiers (called from startup) used to db.tiers.delete_one() any tier whose name was not in AOP_TIER_NAMES allowlist; seed_anniversary_subevents had a wipe block that deleted ALL non-anniversary events on every boot (cascading to rsvps + checkins, which explains the Book Bag Giveaway album photo loss if photos were linked to that event); reconcile_awards similarly deleted+cascaded any non-canonical award. Every production redeploy = startup = full wipe of admin-created content. Fix is correct: those wipe blocks have been removed.

P0 demo-member re-seed fix correct: seed_data() now checks site_settings.demo_seed_completed marker (set once at the end of the function) before re-inserting demo members. Marker already set in preview db.site_settings, and Sam Okafor stayed deleted across a restart in this test — confirmed working. Recommend the SAME pattern be considered for any future canonical-content seed: gate on a one-time marker, not on 'is the document missing'.

F6 auto-clear pending_set_password on login is correct and idempotent: even non-pending users go through the same code path (no-op write avoided in /reset-password flow too — user who reset via /reset-password instead of /set-password now also gets cleared on next login). Verified live: pending=True → admin sets → member logs in → pending=False on next GET.

F5 chapter dropdown — confirmed em-chapter dropdown shows ['DMV','Florida','National','Texas','Tri-South'] (5 options). The inline member-row dropdown (member-{id}-chapter), NewMemberDialog (nm-chapter), and Email blast chapter segment all use the same chapters.map() now. Note: BulkImportMembersDialog at /app/frontend/src/pages/Admin.jsx line 795 still uses officialOnly — this is INTENTIONAL (CSV import maps to canonical chapters) but worth a comment in code so the next dev doesn't 'fix' it back to chapters.map.

Test artifact: F2 in test1 initially failed because the test used field name 'date' instead of 'start_at' — fixed in test2 and PASSED. Models.EventIn requires start_at: datetime. Future tests should reference /app/backend/models.py line 271 for the canonical schema.

MINOR: GET /api/members?q={email} does not filter by email (q=member returned 0; q=sam matched name not email). Not in scope this iteration, but the Admin UI member search may also have this limitation — worth verifying with the user separately.

rca of the issue: Production data-loss RCA: three startup reconciliation functions (reconcile_tiers, seed_anniversary_subevents, reconcile_awards) used a destructive 'delete anything not in canonical allowlist' pattern. On every redeploy (3rd-party hosting at aop-app.org redeploys frequently), startup ran => admin-created tiers/events/awards wiped, with cascade to rsvps/checkins/album-photos. Demo-member re-seed had no completion marker so deleted demos returned on every boot. Fix: removed delete loops, gated demo seed on site_settings.demo_seed_completed marker. All 4 P0 fixes verified surviving an actual sudo supervisorctl restart backend in this test run.
